dPIMustBeAnIntegerFrom72To1200Quality: DPI must be an integer from 72 to 1200; quality must be an integer from 1 to 100.
enterAnOutputDirectoryInsideTheProject: Enter an output directory inside the project.
thisShortcutIsUnavailableOrInUseByAnothe: This shortcut is unavailable or in use by another app. Record a different shortcut and save again.
keepTexgoRunningInTheBackground: Keep Texgo running in the background
relativeToTheProjectExistingManagedPDFsC: Relative to the project. Existing managed PDFs continue updating in their original locations.
monitoringOnlyRefreshesStatusQuickProces: Monitoring only refreshes status. Quick processing updates images; reference changes still need approval.
inTheAppCtrlOToOpenFToSearch: In the app: ⌘/Ctrl + O to open, + F to search, + Enter to process, + Shift + Enter to review. Preview: Space switches Original / PDF / Compare; arrows adjust the divider, Shift takes larger steps, and 0 resets it.
allowImageUpdatesWhileReferencesAwaitRev: Allow image updates while references await review
continueProcessingImagesWithoutSkippingR: Continue processing images without skipping reference review.
appliesAfterSavingLogsContainEventsAndTi: Applies after saving. Logs contain events and timing, not file contents or secrets, and rotate automatically.
